name: toxi
description: Decentralized messaging for Codex, over Tox.

interface.shortDescription: Read and send decentralized toxi messages from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Toxi connects Codex to the local toxi daemon through MCP tools, lifecycle hooks, and a reusable skill. Messages are end-to-end encrypted over Tox and stored locally.
defaultPrompt: Send a toxi message to a contact.
Summarize my recent toxi history with someone.
